memory.content: Use pytest fixtures for test setup - define @pytest.fixture for shared test resources, pass as function params.
Mock external dependencies extensively - use unittest.mock.MagicMock for isolating units, never instantiate real cameras/hardware in tests.
Follow test pyramid - many unit tests (fast, isolated), fewer integration tests (component interaction), fewest system tests (end-to-end).
OpenTelemetry calls should become noops when not configured - use conditional initialization, avoid crashes when metrics/traces unavailable.
Test assertions must be specific to actual method calls - verify exact method names and parameters, not generic mocks.

Metrics use PeriodicExportingMetricReader with OTLPMetricExporter, Resource attributes identify the service, and Meter instruments such as Counter and Histogram record measurements for the configured collector.
